cleaner.label: sbt, Ivy and Coursier (Scala)
cleaner.description: sbt, Ivy and Coursier caches. Does not touch projects or locally published packages (.ivy2\local).

option.label: sbt boot folder
option.description: Removes the Scala and sbt libraries downloaded to .sbt\boot.
option.warning: sbt re-downloads them on the next launch: network required.

option.label: Ivy cache
option.description: Removes the dependencies downloaded to .ivy2\cache. Does not touch .ivy2\local.
option.warning: Re-downloaded on the next dependency resolution. Locally published packages (.ivy2\local) stay.

option.label: Coursier cache
option.description: Removes the dependencies downloaded by Coursier (also used by sbt).
option.warning: Re-downloaded on the next dependency resolution.
